core_claim.P: Minter pulls newly minted HYBR into GaugeManager and no gauges have votes yet (totalWeight == 0)
core_claim.I: GaugeManager must account for all minted HYBR emissions so they flow into gauges and are not orphaned
core_claim.V: index is only updated when totalWeight > 0, so the emission sits on the contract balance, index never increments, and that tranche is lost forever even after voting begins

distinct_impacts.description: The initial emission tranche remains orphaned on the GaugeManager contract balance and is lost forever, even after voting begins.
distinct_impacts.evidence_quote: the emission sits on the contract balance, `index` never increments, and that tranche is lost forever even after voting begins

distinct_impacts.description: The reward pool is permanently shrunk by the orphaned initial emissions.
distinct_impacts.evidence_quote: This permanently shrinks the reward pool

distinct_impacts.description: Accounting assumptions that minted tokens will flow into gauges are broken.
distinct_impacts.evidence_quote: breaks accounting assumptions that minted tokens will flow into gauges
